detail.longDescription: Not just a year ago, you could find a lot of news articles promoting the idea that proprietary AI had higher privacy, better data protection, and enhanced cybersecurity. Now, businesses are switching to Open Source AI for exactly these 3 reasons. I guess reality has caught up with the hype. # cybersecurity # privacy # opensource # AI https://www. marketscale.com/industries/sof tware-and-technology/enterprises-are-ditching-frontier-ai-models-for-open-source-alternatives-to-protect-proprietary-data
